subject: Project Alpha - Security Concerns
body:
Bob,

I've identified several security vulnerabilities in Project Alpha. We need to address these issues before the release.

Critical issues found:
1. SQL Injection vulnerability in login form
2. XSS vulnerability in comment section
3. Weak password hashing implementation

Please review the attached security report.

Regards,
Alice

body:

subject: Suspicious Email Activity Report
body:
Lisa,

I've completed the forensic analysis of the suspicious emails you flagged. Here's my preliminary report:

Findings:
1. 15 emails sent from compromised account (john.user@victim.com)
2. All emails contain malicious attachments
3. Sender IP traced to multiple locations (IP hopping detected)
4. Email headers indicate spoofing attempts

The emails appear to be part of a coordinated phishing campaign. Complete forensic report attached.

Best,
David Miller
Digital Forensics Specialist
